t: A ready-made research robot dog with an open coding kit for developers.
steps: Buy the Go2 EDU from a robot store such as Robotics Center or Top3DShop, and compare bundles carefully.
Charge the battery and test basic walking with the robot.
Set up a Linux computer with Ubuntu and ROS 2 Humble.
Connect the computer to the robot with an Ethernet cable and set a fixed address of 192.168.123.99.
Download unitree_sdk2 or unitree_sdk2_python from GitHub and build it.
Run the high-level example to make the robot stand and walk.
Try unitree_ros2 to read the robot sensors in ROS 2.
Keep the robot on its own private network for safety.
meta: Open Code. From $11,090. A few stores.
